audi-q4-e-tron.note: Both body styles (Q4 and Q4 Sportback 55 e-tron quattro) are rated 251 mi.

genesis-gv60.note: Excludes the 2027 GV60 Magma (EPA 50637, 222 mi), which is a separate model outside this universe (see awd.note).

hyundai-ioniq-5.note: EPA lists no 2027 Ioniq 5 N, so the folded-in N has no range here. Trim mapping from Hyundai's spec sheet ('SE/SEL: 290 miles', 'Limited: 269', 'XRT: 259').

kia-ev3.note: Trim mapping from Kia's spec table ('All Electric Range': Light 221, Wind/Land FWD 321, every AWD trim 280).

nissan-ariya.note: 2025 matches the year of the dimensions quoted. EPA also lists 2026 Ariya AWD versions (ids 50224, 50225, 50228: 205, 272 and 267 mi). Trim mapping from EPA's labels and the 2025 brochure.

subaru-uncharted.note: EPA's 2026 listings (50302, 50303) carry the same figures. Trim mapping from Subaru's spec sheet (Premium FWD 308, Sport 287, GT 273).

toyota-c-hr.note: EPA has no 2027 C-HR yet (2027 Toyota model menu checked 2026-09-19, sources/fe-menu-model-2027-toyota.xml), so these are EPA's 2026 C-HR listings. Toyota's stated 2027 figures are the same: 'an EPA-estimated 287-mile range rating for SE', '273-mile range rating for XSE' (https://www.toyota.com/c-hr/). XSE has 20-in. wheels.

ids.applies_to: Pro AWD, Pro S AWD, Pro S Plus AWD

volkswagen-id4.note: EPA lists a single 2026 ID.4 AWD.

volvo-ec40.note: EPA 2026 EC40 Twin. The EC40's dimensions and trim list come from C/D's 2024 C40 Recharge, so the years don't match.

volvo-ex30.note: As listed by EPA, the Cross Country on 18-inch wheels rates lower than on 19-inch (203 vs 227 mi).

audi-q6-e-tron.note: EPA lists no rear-drive 2027 Q6 e-tron. Sportback is a body variant, included as it is for the Q4.

bmw-ix3.note: One version, five EPA listings by wheel and tire.

cadillac-optiq.note: Excludes the Optiq-V (EPA 50620 and 50621, 278 and 250 mi), a performance variant left out like the Ioniq 5 N and GV60 Magma.

chevrolet-equinox-ev.note: EPA lists a single 2027 Equinox EV, the AWD. The 2026 FWD listing (49953) was 319 mi.

ford-mustang-mach-e.note: EPA's labels name the battery, not Ford's trims; Select and Premium both come with eAWD.

genesis-electrified-gv70.note: EPA lists a single 2027 Electrified GV70. Its 2026 listings split by wheel: 263 mi on 19-in. (49656), 243 mi on 20-in. (49657).

jeep-wagoneer-s.note: 2025 matches the year of the dimensions quoted. EPA also lists 2026 (50209, 50210: 294 and 268 mi). EPA's labels name the tire, not Jeep's trims.

mercedes-benz-glc-class-ev.note: EPA has no electric GLC listing (2027 Mercedes-Benz model menu checked 2026-09-19, sources/fe-menu-model-2027-mercedes-benz.xml). Figures are Mercedes-Benz USA's, from its 2027 quick reference guide.

polestar-3.note: Polestar's US page doesn't state a model year; 2026 is EPA's latest Polestar 3 listing.

porsche-macan-electric.note: 2026 matches the year of the dimensions quoted (C/D). Porsche USA already lists 2027 variants.

rivian-r2.note: EPA lists only the R2 Performance so far; Rivian says the Standard is 'Coming 2027'.

subaru-solterra.note: 2026 matches the year of the spec sheet quoted. EPA's 2027 listings (50690, 50689) carry the same figures. EPA's labels name the wheel size, not Subaru's trims.

subaru-trailseeker.note: EPA's labels name the wheel size, not Subaru's trims.

tesla-model-y.note: Trim mapping from Tesla's Model Y page (Premium All-Wheel Drive 327 mi, Performance 306 mi, Premium Rear-Wheel Drive 357 mi). Excludes the long-wheelbase Model Y L, a different body that EPA doesn't list.

toyota-bz.note: EPA has no 2027 bZ yet (sources/fe-menu-model-2027-toyota.xml), so these are EPA's 2026 listings. toyota.com's 2027 page states the same AWD figure: 'a 288-mile EPA-estimated range rating on XLE AWD'. FWD entries carry EPA's own labels; they weren't mapped to Toyota's trims. Excludes the bZ Woodland (50305, 50306), a separate model outside this universe.

volvo-ex60.note: EPA lists no P12 AWD yet; Volvo says P12 deliveries are 'expected to start in 2027'.
